operating_notes.text: Consolidated service-unit revenue was ₹126.65 Cr in Q4FY26, up 23.8% YoY, while its segment result before interest and tax fell to ₹12.37 Cr from ₹17.83 Cr.
The company adopted straight-line depreciation from 1 April 2025, cutting FY26 depreciation by ₹7.37 Cr and raising PBT by the same amount.
A one-time ₹2.73 Cr charge for the new labour codes (gratuity and leave encashment) is booked as an exceptional item for FY26.
